premises.text: Email is a fundamental communication tool for businesses that often leads to inefficiencies.
premises.evidence_span: the email problem is so big it's just bugged us for years and years

premises.text: Making email more productive can reduce wasted time and enhance collaboration.
premises.evidence_span: we want to do is make email more productive, so it wastes less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

premises.text: A loop is a smart mailing list that enhances email functionality.
premises.evidence_span: what we call the loop. The loop is a smart mailing list, easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Users can create loops easily via email without needing IT support.
premises.evidence_span: There was no IT help desk request. No one had to download anything. No one had to learn anything because it's just email

premises.text: The web interface provides easy access to loop content and enhances search capabilities.
premises.evidence_span: the web interface has all the threads, all the content, all the attachments. It has great search

premises.text: Loops can be made open to the whole company, enhancing visibility and collaboration.
premises.evidence_span: he made it open to the whole company. If you have an Acme email address, you can search it, you can follow it

premises.text: Email lists have intrinsic virality, which can enhance user adoption.
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral, which is part of what got us interested in the idea in the first place

premises.text: The freemium model can be effectively implemented due to the nature of email.
premises.evidence_span: the freemium model really easy or easier

premises.text: Users do not need to change their behavior significantly to adopt the loop.
premises.evidence_span: we don't ask for behavior changes because it's just email

value.text: Email can be made more productive and collaborative through the use of loops.
